---
title: "missing_provider"
description: "A React hook was used outside its actor context's `<Provider>`."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** A React hook was used outside its actor context's `<Provider>`.

**How to fix it:** Render the component inside `<ActorContext.Provider>`.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
